prompt: Here's a resumable upload service from our file-upload module. `finalizeUpload` merges all the chunk files for an upload into the final file and returns a SHA-256 checksum the client can verify against. It's correct today, but it's not efficient — walk me through why, and tell me exactly how you'd restructure `finalizeUpload` to fix it. Assume uploads can be several GB, so both I/O count and peak memory matter. Also touch on the trade-off of computing the checksum at finalize time versus per-chunk (as in the tus checksum extension).
